g.text: LyonRank4Convo2 begins.
¿Cómo es posible que tú y Marie puedan conciliar el ser sacerdote y monja, pero también… cometer actos de violencia?
¿Puedo hacerte una pregunta un poco extraña, Lyon?
[Fin.]

Oigo a Marie gritar "¡païens!" y lanzarse a la pelea, y... aun así, me cuesta creer que sea el tipo de persona que condena a alguien por tener creencias diferentes. Me imagino que tú tampoco eres muy diferente. Está claro que te tiene en muy alta estima.
¿Cómo se sentiría tu iglesia con lo que tú y Marie están haciendo aquí? ¿Con respecto a lo que se les pide que hagan en su nombre?
Los miro a ti y a Marie en el campo de batalla, y luego hablo con ella en privado, y los veo leyendo libros tranquilamente... y supongo que me está costando alinear a esos individuos en mi mente.
Si te parece que describir nuestra situación actual es simplemente "extraña", me impresiona tu fortaleza o me consterna tu falta de vocabulario. Sin embargo, sospecho que es lo primero.
Chat ends.
Tienes toda la razón. Marie no es de las que condenan a alguien por albergar en su corazón a un antiguo dios de los árboles; en cambio, buscaría descubrir qué creencias compartía con ellos.

En su época se libraron muchas guerras santas en nombre de Sol o Lua. Sangrientas "cruzadas" para expulsar a los paganos, "tomar tierra santa" o cualquier razonamiento artificioso que prevaleciera en la época.
+5 Chemistry

¿Es acaso que el árbol no se nutre de la luz de Sol? ¿No hay un punto en común donde pueda compartir el pan con ellos? Es más propensa a sentarse y escuchar sus historias que a intentar perjudicarlos por su fe.
La Ortodoxia Luminaria no tiene ejército ni libra guerras. No impiden que quienes pertenecen a su orden actúen ni protejan a otros.
Es decir, sí, adelante. No puedes hacerme sentir más extraño preguntándome lo que te intriga.

Cuando ella se enfrenta a su enemigo en el campo de batalla, creo que es una de dos cosas: o se está divirtiendo un poco, actuando como una antigua defensora, imaginándose a sí misma con una brillante armadura de un caballero del Sol -

When Marie engages with her foes upon the battlefield, I believe it is one of two things: either, she is having a bit of fun, play-acting as an ancient crusader, imagining herself in the shining armor of a Knight of Sol -
O, lo más probable, está recordando a Ástafor 8:23: "Solas son las almas que buscan entrar en mi casa por la fuerza, porque son los expulsados de la luz de Sol".
En sus ojos, la violencia que comete es justa en el nombre de un bien mayor, como lo harías tú, como lo harían aquellos junto a quienes luchan, supongo.

Y por eso, aquellos contra quienes ella lucha, independientemente de su religión, son expulsados ​​por el Sol. Incluso si llevan las vestiduras sagradas de su propia orden, a los ojos de ella, son paganos.
He notado que te has alejado de esto. ¿Cómo te sientes con todo esto de las batallas?
Eso tiene sentido. Gracias.
Estoy siendo intencionadamente elusivo, Viajero.
+5 Chemistry
Y estoy siendo muy persistente, sacerdote.
Está bien. Hoy tomaré lo que pueda conseguir.
Por si sirve de algo, Marie... me ha dicho que tienes buenas intenciones. Y le creo a ella, incluso cuando yo no lo puedo creer.
+10 Chemistry
Al final, solo puedo pedirte paciencia. Lua sabe que casi siempre me falta.
Muy bien. Si no te dejas disuadir, ¿y tienes tanta curiosidad? No me preocupa tanto la muerte que causo como... tal vez podrías esperar.
-F. Lyon Allard
Or that one might feel is "proper" for a man of the cloth and a scholar such as I.
Chat ends.
I've known more war than peace in my life, Lyon. If I let it trouble me, I don't think I would still be here. But that isn't to say it doesn't still come with a real burden - a real cost.

I'm sure the others have told you who I am. What I am. Where I've come from. The death that follows me - the death I've come from. The death that defines me. Do you think anything you feel will surprise me?
Add 1 to Thermostat
Add -1 to Thermostat
Yes, it does.
Yes, I do.
I'm sorry. I feel I've upset you. That wasn't my intention.
Do you... care to elaborate?
You are not to blame, Drifter. I am, as our brothers and sisters from Libertatia might say, a "hard nut to crack."
The horrors that echo within my mind seem to know no boundaries. I witness chains of human sinew that once oozed with fresh crimson, turned brittle and blackened.
I am merely a besieged individual. I hold the wall. To open the gate is to threaten the integrity of the defenses.
I see a hundred thousand visages of my own self, similar but foreign. Hollowed caskets, corpses of twisted, broken human flesh, suspended in the veil between life and death.
I understand. When you're ready, we can talk.
How do you mean?
Expressions locked in a mask of empty repose. But in the flickering remains of their souls, embers that linger and do not die, I hear them screaming. Endlessly howling for retribution. For freedom.
I am starting to come to the distinct impression that I do not have a choice in this matter.
For death.
+15 Chemistry
These visions haunt my waking hours. My dreams. I have no nightmares, for that is all I experience - all I have become.
But, for what it is worth, Marie... has told me you mean well. And I believe her, even when I do not believe myself.
Check boolean LyonPainOff
All I may do is beg your patience, in the end. Lua knows I run short of it with myself most days.
Only when I sacrifice to the whispers that echo within my soul, is the world reflected to me in a manner similar to that which you might find familiar.
true
Only when I rend the flesh from my body as a sacrifice to the whispers that echo within my soul, is the world reflected to me in a manner similar to that which you might find familiar.
false
-F. Lyon Allard
Kindly do not pretend to know of what I "feel," Drifter. I fear you have only begun to understand.
Update boolean LyonVisions2d
I - I'm sorry. No, I didn't know.
And there is a lot of horror and pain that I have seen that you do not understand either, Lyon.
I'm sorry if you feel I spoke out of turn. But I want to understand. These visions of yours...
Chat ends.
Yes. Well. I have survived these long years. I will hold strong a few more, I am certain. You needn't worry over much.
I am most certain you have, seeing some of it reflected in the imagery of this place. But do you think yourself paramount? Supreme Knower of All Horrors and All Suffering?
Yes. Well. I have withstood them all my years. I will hold strong a few more, I am certain. You needn't worry over much.
Update boolean LyonVisions2a
I'm saying I might be able to sympathize more with what you're experiencing than you think.
I'm saying I've been through a lot of death and horror, Lyon. So I don't enjoy being spoken down to over it.
What you're describing, Lyon... did that vision start before or after you were a protoframe?
Can we talk about this again? Please?
Update boolean LyonVisions2b
Update boolean LyonVisions2c
Were that as simple a question as you believe it to be. Regardless, it is not one I am willing to answer today. I feel a headache coming on.
I am starting to come to the distinct impression that I do not have a choice in this matter.
It may seem strange to you that I am not in search of sympathy, Drifter. Answers are what I seek. Surety. Firmament, when all is illusion and lies.
Than allow me to bow down at your feet. Praise you for all you have endured. Wonder how you are still sane for all you have witnessed.
+10 Chemistry
I'll do what I can.
Then, maybe I can help you with that. Can we talk about this again? Please?
And marvel over how you still spare time for all the rest of us who you view so far beneath your vaulted status.
But, for what it is worth, Marie... has told me you mean well. And I believe her, even when I do not believe myself.
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
All I may do is beg your patience, in the end. Lua knows I run short of it with myself most days.
That is all one can ask for, is it not?
-F. Lyon Allard
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
